From $20,000. Fixed-price. Full IP. 24-hour response.

sections.title: International Private Banking and Wealth Chatbots

blocks.heading: Spanish-English and Portuguese-English wealth management chatbots
paragraphs: Multilingual wealth management service chatbots for Miami's international private banks (Citigroup Private Bank, HSBC Private Banking, Itaú BBA Private) — enabling Latin American high-net-worth clients to access portfolio information, account services, and investment product information in Spanish or Portuguese as preferred.

blocks.heading: International client onboarding chatbots
paragraphs: FATCA-aware multilingual onboarding assistance chatbots for the international clients opening US private banking relationships through Miami — navigating the complex KYC documentation requirements for foreign nationals establishing US banking relationships.

blocks.heading: Cross-border financial planning chatbots
paragraphs: Chatbots addressing the specific cross-border wealth management needs of Miami's international client base — US/Latin America tax treaty questions, inheritance planning across jurisdictions, and the currency management needs of clients with assets in multiple countries.

sections.title: Healthcare Navigation Chatbots (Multilingual)
sections.description: For Baptist Health South Florida, Jackson Health System, and Cleveland Clinic Florida.

blocks.heading: Multilingual patient navigation
paragraphs: Spanish, Portuguese, Haitian Creole, and additional language healthcare chatbots for Miami's extraordinary demographic diversity — appointment scheduling, symptom guidance, health plan navigation, and care coordination chatbots in the languages of Miami's diverse patient communities.

blocks.heading: HIPAA + Florida health privacy-compliant design
paragraphs: Healthcare chatbots in Florida must comply with HIPAA and Florida's health information privacy protections — ClickMasters designs Miami healthcare chatbots with dual federal-state compliance.

blocks.heading: Medical tourism navigation chatbots
paragraphs: Chatbots for the international medical tourism patients who choose Miami's world-class medical facilities (Cleveland Clinic Florida, Baptist Health) for specialized care — navigating the complex billing, insurance, and care coordination logistics for international patients.

sections.title: Real Estate Client Service Chatbots

blocks.heading: International buyer real estate chatbots
paragraphs: Spanish, Portuguese, and English real estate inquiry chatbots for the Miami luxury real estate market's large international buyer community — answering property questions, showing scheduling, and international buyer financing guidance for the Latin American and European buyers who represent a significant portion of Miami's luxury real estate demand.

blocks.heading: Property management client chatbots
paragraphs: Tenant and owner chatbots for Miami's large residential property management community — multilingual service for the Spanish and Creole-speaking tenants in Miami's large rental apartment market.

sections.title: Hospitality Concierge Chatbots
sections.description: For Four Seasons Miami, Mandarin Oriental, and Miami's luxury hospitality community.

blocks.heading: Luxury hotel concierge chatbots
paragraphs: Multilingual concierge AI chatbots for Miami's luxury hotels — answering guest questions, making restaurant and activity recommendations, and coordinating guest services in the multiple languages spoken by Miami's diverse luxury traveler community.

blocks.heading: Latin American restaurant and hospitality chatbots
paragraphs: Spanish-English chatbots for Miami's large Latin American restaurant and hospitality industry — reservation assistance, menu inquiries, and event booking for the Spanish-speaking customer base that represents a large share of Miami's dining market.

sections.title: Miami chatbot technical context
sections.description: Key technical considerations for Miami chatbot deployments.

blocks.heading: Multilingual at Miami baseline
paragraphs: ClickMasters designs all Miami consumer-facing chatbots with Spanish as minimum language support, with Portuguese and Haitian Creole as common additions for healthcare and public-facing applications. Language expansion beyond Spanish adds $5,000–$10,000 per language for production-quality chatbot implementation.

blocks.heading: Florida Digital Privacy
paragraphs: Florida's Digital Bill of Rights creates consumer data governance requirements for Miami's consumer-facing chatbot applications.

blocks.heading: Cultural competency requirements
paragraphs: Language translation is necessary but not sufficient for Miami's multilingual market — Latin American consumers have specific cultural preferences, communication styles, and service expectations that differ between Colombian, Brazilian, Venezuelan, Cuban, and Argentinian communities. ClickMasters designs Miami chatbots with cultural adaptation beyond literal translation.
